tags.name: Screening Questions
tags.description: Standardized HR screening question repository, role-based question filtering, and multilingual question templates.

tags.name: Screening Sessions
tags.description: Candidate screening session lifecycle, pipeline creation, session status tracking, and conversation start.

tags.name: Candidate Answers
tags.description: Candidate verbal and text answer ingestion, segment tagging, and conversational dialog interactions.

tags.name: Audio and Transcription
tags.description: Candidate voice audio upload, speech-to-text processing, Whisper model transcription, and transcript cleaning.

tags.name: Intent and Information Extraction
tags.description: Natural language intent classification, entity extraction (skills, experience, notice period, salary), and answer validation.

tags.name: Screening Evaluation
tags.description: 4-factor scoring rubric (Clarity, Relevance, Completeness, Consistency), behavioral indicators, and session completion.

tags.name: Screening Reports
tags.description: Recruiter-ready candidate screening reports, structured answer analysis, strengths, risks, and recommendations.

tags.name: HR Interview Engine
tags.description: AI HR interview session management, role/experience-based question bank generation, and conversation state machine.

tags.name: HR Dynamic Follow-Up
tags.description: Adaptive follow-up question triggers, completeness checks, deepening inquiries, and repetition control.

tags.name: HR Communication & Behavioral Evaluation
tags.description: Multi-factor communication fluency, grammar, vocabulary, filler penalties, hesitation tracking, and ethical safeguards.

tags.name: HR Interview Scoring & Reports
tags.description: 4-factor scoring rubric, aptitude evaluation, 11-section recruiter report generation, HTML export, and hiring decisions.

tags.name: ATS
tags.description: Applicant Tracking System core: job openings, candidate ingestion, resume upload, parsing, and shortlisting.

tags.name: System
tags.description: System health checks, recruiter authentication session management, and metrics.
